lender_decisions_amount_consistent.name: lender_decisions_amount_consistent
lender_decisions_amount_consistent.value:
("lender_decisions"."decision" = 'APPROVED' and "lender_decisions"."approved_amount" is not null and "lender_decisions"."approved_amount" > 0)
          or ("lender_decisions"."decision" = 'REJECTED' and "lender_decisions"."approved_amount" is null)

loan_applications_attribution_consistent.name: loan_applications_attribution_consistent
loan_applications_attribution_consistent.value:
("loan_applications"."acquisition_source" = 'DIRECT' and "loan_applications"."referring_agent_id" is null and "loan_applications"."referral_id" is null)
          or ("loan_applications"."acquisition_source" = 'AGENT_REFERRAL' and "loan_applications"."referring_agent_id" is not null)

commission_rules_calc_fields.name: commission_rules_calc_fields
commission_rules_calc_fields.value:
("commission_rules"."calc_type" = 'PERCENTAGE' and "commission_rules"."rate_percent" is not null)
          or ("commission_rules"."calc_type" = 'FIXED' and "commission_rules"."fixed_amount" is not null)
          or ("commission_rules"."calc_type" = 'SLAB' and "commission_rules"."slabs" is not null)
